name: EA Stop Order
summary: This EA places stop orders (buy stop and sell stop) at a configurable distance from the current price, aiming to capture breakout momentum when price moves beyond a defined range. It automatically manages pending orders with stop loss and take profit levels, and can trail stops or delete unfilled orders after a specified period. The strategy is a classic stop-order breakout system suitable for volatile market conditions.
summary_zh: 该EA在当前价格的一定距离处放置止损订单（买入止损和卖出止损），旨在捕捉价格突破定义区间后的动量。它自动管理挂单的止损和止盈水平，并可在指定时间后追踪止损或删除未成交订单。该策略是经典的止损订单突破系统，适合波动性较大的市场环境。
strategy_analysis: EA Stop Order采用经典的止损挂单突破策略，在当前价格上方放置买入止损单(Buy Stop)，在当前价格下方放置卖出止损单(Sell Stop)。入场条件为价格突破预设的距离阈值，确认突破方向后跟随趋势进场。出场条件通过止损和止盈参数控制，每笔交易都有明确的风险回报比设定。仓位管理基于固定的手数参数，部分版本支持基于账户余额的动态手数计算。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损距离参数来控制单笔风险，但缺乏整体账户风险控制机制如最大回撤限制或连续亏损保护。EA还具备挂单超时删除功能，避免在盘整行情中频繁触发假突破。
strategy_analysis_en: EA Stop Order employs a classic stop-order breakout strategy by placing a Buy Stop above the current price and a Sell Stop below it. The entry condition is triggered when price breaks through a pre-configured distance threshold, confirming the breakout direction before entering in the trend's direction. Exit conditions are controlled through stop loss and take profit parameters, ensuring each trade has a defined risk-reward ratio. Position sizing is based on a fixed lot parameter, with some versions supporting dynamic lot calculation based on account balance. Money management provides stop loss distance parameters to control per-trade risk, but lacks comprehensive account-level risk controls such as maximum drawdown limits or consecutive loss protection. The EA also features pending order timeout deletion to avoid frequent false breakout triggers during ranging markets.

parameters.name: StopDistance
parameters.description: 止损挂单距离当前价格的点数
parameters.description_en: Stop order distance from current price in points

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: Manage positions with specific magic number only; 0 manages all

parameters.name: OrderExpire
parameters.description: 挂单过期时间(小时)，0为不过期
parameters.description_en: Pending order expiration in hours; 0 for no expiration

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调优，适合初学者使用
使用止损挂单突破方式入场，能够有效捕捉趋势启动的动量行情
每笔交易都有明确的止损和止盈设置，风险回报比可控
挂单超时删除机制可减少假突破带来的不必要损失
支持双向挂单，不错过任何方向的突破机会
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and optimize, suitable for beginners
Stop order breakout entry effectively captures momentum at trend initiation
Each trade has defined stop loss and take profit, maintaining controllable risk-reward ratio
Pending order timeout deletion reduces unnecessary losses from false breakouts
Bi-directional pending orders ensure no breakout opportunity is missed in either direction
cons: 缺乏账户级别的资金管理，没有最大回撤限制或每日亏损限制
固定手数下单不考虑账户余额变化，可能导致过度交易或资金利用不足
在震荡行情中容易频繁触发假突破，造成连续止损
没有新K线检查机制，可能每tick都尝试下单，浪费资源
缺乏市场波动率过滤(如ATR)，在高波动和低波动市场使用相同参数效果差异大
cons_en: Lacks account-level money management with no maximum drawdown or daily loss limits
Fixed lot sizing ignores account balance changes, potentially leading to overtrading or underutilization of capital
Prone to frequent false breakout triggers during ranging markets, causing consecutive stop losses
No new bar check mechanism, may attempt to place orders every tick, wasting resources
Lacks volatility filter (e.g., ATR), using identical parameters across different volatility regimes produces inconsistent results
improvements: 增加基于ATR的自适应止损距离和挂单距离，使策略能根据市场波动率自动调整参数
添加账户级别的风险控制，包括最大回撤限制、每日最大亏损限制和连续亏损后暂停交易功能
实现动态仓位管理，基于账户余额和风险百分比自动计算手数
improvements_en: Add ATR-based adaptive stop distance and order placement distance, enabling the strategy to auto-adjust parameters based on market volatility
Implement account-level risk controls including maximum drawdown limits, daily maximum loss limits, and trading pause after consecutive losses
Implement dynamic position sizing that auto-calculates lot size based on account balance and risk percentage

risk_points: 震荡行情中双向挂单容易同时触发止损，造成双重亏损
没有新K线检查，可能导致重复下单或资源浪费
缺乏市场环境过滤机制，在不适用的行情中依然持续交易
risk_points_en: Bi-directional pending orders in ranging markets can trigger both stop losses simultaneously, causing double losses
No new bar check may lead to duplicate order placement or resource waste
Lacks market regime filter, continues trading even in unsuitable market conditions
